$comment: Vectors pinning how a recorded Checksum.value is compared with the digest computed over the referenced bytes. Checksum.value carries no case constraint in the schema, so a hex digest recorded in uppercase or mixed case (PowerShell's Get-FileHash writes uppercase) names the same bytes as its lowercase spelling. Each uri resolves under testdata/evidence. Shared by go/evidence_parity_test.go and test/evidence.test.ts so the two verifiers cannot drift.

vectors.why: lowercase, as this toolchain records it: the control case
the correct digest in uppercase is the same digest, not a changed file
mixed case under another algorithm: case-folding is a property of hex, not of sha256
an uppercase digest of DIFFERENT bytes still mismatches, and the report quotes the value exactly as recorded
